A = Checkpoint("A"); B = Checkpoint("B")
keys = A.keys()
rows = []
for k in keys:
    if "embed" in k or "lm_head" in k:
        a = A.get(k); b = B.get(k)
        print(k, "identical:", np.array_equal(a, b), "lm_head==embed:", np.array_equal(A.get("lm_head.weight"), A.get("model.embed_tokens.weight")) if k=="lm_head.weight" else "")
        continue
    a = A.get(k); b = B.get(k)
    d = a - b
    rel = np.linalg.norm(d) / (np.linalg.norm(a) + 1e-12)
    frac = np.mean(d != 0)
    er = None
    if d.ndim == 2:
        s = np.linalg.svd(d, compute_uv=False)
        p = s**2 / (s**2).sum()
        er = (s[0]**2/(s**2).sum(), np.exp(-(p*np.log(p+1e-30)).sum()))
    rows.append((k, np.linalg.norm(d), rel, frac, er))
def lkey(r):
    m = re.search(r"layers\.(\d+)\.(.*)", r[0]); return (int(m.group(1)), m.group(2)) if m else (-1, r[0])
for r in sorted(rows, key=lkey):
    print(f"{r[0]:55s} |d|={r[1]:.4f} rel={r[2]:.4f} nz={r[3]:.3f}", "" if r[4] is None else f"top1var={r[4][0]:.3f} erank={r[4][1]:.1f}")

A = Checkpoint("A"); B = Checkpoint("B")
os.makedirs("/work", exist_ok=True)
E = A.get("model.embed_tokens.weight")
np.save("/work/E.npy", E)
L = 18
summ = []
for l in range(L):
    line = [l]
    for t in ["self_attn.q_proj","self_attn.k_proj","self_attn.v_proj","self_attn.o_proj","mlp.gate_proj","mlp.up_proj","mlp.down_proj"]:
        k = f"model.layers.{l}.{t}.weight"
        a = A.get(k); b = B.get(k)
        np.save(f"/work/A_{l}_{t}.npy", a); np.save(f"/work/B_{l}_{t}.npy", b)
        line.append(np.linalg.norm(a-b)/np.linalg.norm(a))
    for t in ["input_layernorm","post_attention_layernorm","pre_feedforward_layernorm","post_feedforward_layernorm","self_attn.q_norm","self_attn.k_norm"]:
        k = f"model.layers.{l}.{t}.weight"
        np.save(f"/work/A_{l}_{t}.npy", A.get(k)); np.save(f"/work/B_{l}_{t}.npy", B.get(k))
    summ.append(line)
np.save("/work/A_norm.npy", A.get("model.norm.weight"))
print("layer  q      k      v      o      gate   up     down  (rel diff)")
for s in summ:
    print(s[0], " ".join(f"{x:.4f}" for x in s[1:]))
fn = A.get("model.norm.weight")
print("final norm weight stats", fn.mean(), fn.min(), fn.max())
for l in [0, 5, 11, 17]:
    print(l, "post_ff norm mean", A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.post_feedforward_layernorm.weight").mean(), "post_attn", A.get(f"model.layers.{l}.post_attention_layernorm.weight").mean())

tok = Tokenizer("A")
E = np.load("/work/E.npy")
# English-ish token subset
ids = []
for i in range(262144):
    s = tok.id_to_token.get(i)
    if s is None or i in tok.special: continue
    t = s.replace("▁", " ")
    if re.fullmatch(r" ?[A-Za-z]{2,12}", t) or re.fullmatch(r" ?[0-9]{1,4}", t) or re.fullmatch(r" ?[A-Z]", t):
        ids.append(i)
ids = np.array(ids)
print(len(ids), ids[:20], ids[-20:])
print([tok.text(i) for i in ids[:50]])
np.save("/work/eng_ids.npy", ids)
S = ids[:8000]
ES = E[S]
dfin = 1 + np.load("/work/A_norm.npy")
res = []
for l in range(18):
    din = {s: 1 + np.load(f"/work/{s}_{l}_input_layernorm.npy") for s in "AB"}
    dpa = {s: 1 + np.load(f"/work/{s}_{l}_post_attention_layernorm.npy") for s in "AB"}
    WV = {s: np.load(f"/work/{s}_{l}_self_attn.v_proj.npy") for s in "AB"}
    WO = {s: np.load(f"/work/{s}_{l}_self_attn.o_proj.npy") for s in "AB"}
    for h in range(4):
        diags = {}
        for s in "AB":
            OV = WO[s][:, h*256:(h+1)*256] @ WV[s]  # 640x640
            Xin = ES * din[s]          # N x 640
            out = Xin @ OV.T           # N x 640  (OV applied to each token)
            Uout = ES * (dfin * dpa[s])  # N x 640
            diag = np.sum(out * Uout, 1)
            # mean of row (logit of other tokens) approx via mean unembedding
            meanU = Uout.mean(0)
            base = out @ meanU
            sd = np.std(out @ Uout[:500].T)
            diags[s] = (diag - base) / sd
        res.append((l, h, diags["A"].mean(), diags["B"].mean(), (diags["A"]-diags["B"]).mean(), np.mean(diags["A"]>diags["B"])))
print("layer head copyA copyB A-B fracA>B")
for r in res:
    print(f"{r[0]:2d} {r[1]} {r[2]:8.3f} {r[3]:8.3f} {r[4]:8.4f} {r[5]:.3f}")
